rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person, thing, or case excluded from a general rule.

example.english: Everyone has to follow this rule; there’s no exception.
example.traditional: 呢條規矩人人都要遵守，冇例外。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 kwai1 geoi2 jan4 jan4 dou1 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 mou5 lai6 ngoi6
